readout_other: 120-electrode multielectrode array recordings of retinal ganglion cell spiking
direction_notes: US reliably activated RGCs (98.28% of channels responded); with increasing intensity latency shortened, firing rate rose and response type shifted (e.g. ON-transient cells began to respond at both onset and offset).

exposures.label: 2.25 MHz focused US on isolated rat retina

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed mode: PRF 1 kHz, tone burst duration 0.5 ms, sonication duration 400 ms, interstimulus interval 2 s; 15 stimulus trains per experiment with a 3 min pause between experiments. Intensity varied by function generator voltage.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A 2.25 MHz focused US transducer was used in this study.

source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.ispta_w_cm2: It was calculated from the measured acoustic pressures and the set sonication parameters using equations described in the literature [28].

flags.reason: Intensity was varied; the paper gives individual values (threshold 0.28 W/cm2, 12.84 W/cm2 in Fig 5, saturation around 12.84 to 13.16 W/cm2), not a stated sweep range. Two-element list is the threshold and the upper value; quote carries only the upper value. Ispta was calculated from pressure and scaled by 46.34% for the filter membrane.
Peak pressure 331 kPa is from a hydrophone scan in a water tank, not explicitly tied to the stimulation settings; the filter membrane attenuated peak pressure (38 vs 82 kPa).
Valpey Fisher is a named maker not in the list; mapped to other_manufacturer.
